page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 6 physical cores and 12 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Vector processing instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware-assisted cryptographic support via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI extensions.

The instance is provisioned with 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Memory performance testing demonstrates an uncached read bandwidth of 82.85 GB/sec and an uncached write bandwidth of 53.59 GB/sec, supporting fast throughput for memory-resident datasets. In benchmark evaluations, the server achieves average-tier scores across general computing suites, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 7,921.0 and a multi-core stress-ng rating of 11,658.63. Database transaction testing records 6,125.12 operations on Passmark and 11.97 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks.

Hardware tradeoffs include the absence of integrated local storage, which mandates dependency on external network-attached block storage for persistence. Network throughput is bounded by a 4 Gbps baseline, and the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. While integer throughput, compression, and in-memory key-value processing hold steady in the middle tier, larger compute-intensive operations exhibit clear constraints; for instance, medium-scale 7B model prompt processing falls into the lower 25th percentile at 24.38 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated acceleration.

With its generous memory footprint per core, ecs.r7se.3xlarge delivers cost-efficient resource density for workloads demanding high memory capacity without the overhead of massive compute allocations. It is best configured for in-memory caching systems, transactional relational databases, large Redis or Memcached instances, enterprise application runtimes, and intermediate ETL batch processing jobs.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.3xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs and 6 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. It offers 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio tailored for memory-intensive operations. The instance lacks bundled local storage and GPUs, relying on external network-attached block storage and a 4 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results position the server in the middle performance tier for standard compute, memory bandwidth, and database operations, highlighted by 11.97 million Redis SET operations per second and 82.85 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. Due to its balanced compute-to-memory allocation and AVX-512 instruction support, ecs.r7se.3xlarge delivers efficient density for in-memory caches, distributed databases, memory-resident analytics, and transactional enterprise backends.
